posts.title: Visualizing systems with Mermaid
posts.description: A quick example of rendering Mermaid diagrams inside the site.
posts.html:
Modern docs benefit from visual explanations. Here's a simple architecture sketch:

graph TD
  User[User] -->|browses| WebApp[Web App]
  WebApp -->|reads| BlogData[blogs.json]
  BlogData -->|links| Images[(public assets)]

And here's a sequence diagram for a request lifecycle:

sequenceDiagram
  participant Browser
  participant App
  participant Blogs
  Browser->>App: Navigate to #/blog/mermaid-demo
  App->>Blogs: Load blog HTML
  App-->>Browser: Render article
  Browser->>Browser: Mermaid renders diagrams

posts.title: Welcome to the blog
posts.description: Why I added a blog and what to expect.
posts.html:
Why a blog?

I've wanted a space to write about projects that go beyond the bullet points on my resume. Expect architecture sketches, debug stories, and quick notes on tools I've enjoyed using.

What to expect

  • Short notes that take less than five minutes to read
  • Diagrams and code samples you can skim quickly
  • Links to demos or repos whenever possible
